sermon.title: Jesus Christ and Apologetics
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God doesn’t need defending—we need to preach the gospel. Watching Jesus answer the Sadducees’ trap about marriage in the resurrection, he shows Jesus used Scripture and revelation: we will be like the angels, and “I am the God of Abraham” proves the dead live. Like Job, we can know God personally rather than by intellect.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “John 3:30” for John 3:34; “Sixth commandment thou shalt not commit adultery” (seventh in the Protestant list); “first Corinthians 12” for 14:6 (spoken “12”); Job “about the time of Abraham” and “2,000 years” before Christ; Matthew 27 saints rising alluded to. Sensitive content kept as spoken: his Assembly of God church listed as a cult; Jehovah’s Witnesses and Mormons recruiting young Christians; Genesis 6 angel view — “how dumb these people are”; two divorces, children defaming him, two church splits, false adultery accusations; Protestants “right” to separate from the Catholic church.

faqs.question: What is apologetics?
faqs.answer: Arguments defending the Bible and truth.

faqs.question: Does God need defending?
faqs.answer: No; preach the gospel and let him work.

faqs.question: What did Jesus say in Luke 16:15?
faqs.answer: You are they which justify yourselves before men.

faqs.question: What does one sent by God speak?
Who opens our understanding of Scripture?
faqs.answer: Jesus Christ and the Holy Spirit.

faqs.question: What two things did Jesus say the Sadducees didn’t know?
faqs.answer: The scriptures and the power of God.

faqs.question: Is there marriage in the resurrection?
faqs.answer: No; we will be like the angels.

faqs.question: Why does “I am the God of Abraham” matter?
faqs.answer: It’s present tense; they’re still alive.

faqs.question: Is it embarrassing to say “I don’t know”?
faqs.answer: No, but get an answer and don’t fake it.
